room.storeroom.title: Storeroom
room.storeroom.description: A cramped storeroom. Under a shelf, the chest's [lock](lock) faces the room. A thin [wooden door](wooden_door) leads north and an [iron door](iron_door) east.
room.north_room.title: North Room
room.east_room.title: East Room
detail.lock: A simple lock with no keyhole for any key you have.
detail.wooden_door: A thin, fragile wooden door with a fair lock.
detail.wooden_door.jammed: A thin, fragile wooden door. Its lock is jammed; picking it is no use now, but the wood might give to a shoulder.
detail.iron_door: A solid iron door. No shoulder will move it.
item.chest.description: A small chest whose lid will not open until its lock is picked.
skill.pick.label: Lockpicking
narration.pick_door.failure: The pick snaps in the lock; it is jammed.
narration.force_door.success: The wooden door gives under your shoulder.
